question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
-- Step 1: Find strikers who scored > 50 in any single match
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker, bbb.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
      ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs > 50
)
-- Step 2: Average of total runs scored by these qualifying strikers (across all their matches)
SELECT AVG(smr.total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_match_runs smr
WHERE smr.striker IN (SELECT striker FROM qualifying_strikers)
